private_api.AsyncClient._queue_qos0_on_loop / _queue: source of the rebound façade fast path
private_api.AsyncClient._reconfigure: loop-confined config boundary used to set keepalive before connect
private_api.Client._async: façade ctor exposes no max_outbound_inflight (through 1.0.0rc1); the inner AsyncClient is rebuilt so QoS>=1 runs the same window as peers
private_api.Client._loop: needed to schedule the properties publish path on the façade's own loop
private_api.Client._queue_qos0_on_loop / _queue_qosn: façade caches these bound methods at construction; rebound after the inner client is replaced
private_api.Client._run_loop_mutation: applies the bench keepalive on the façade's loop before connecting
private_api.Client._submit: connect() must pass an SSLContext, which the façade's own connect() does not accept
